meta.task: TASK C: takers, price dynamics, burstiness, correlated shocks (calibration parameters for a Polymarket-shaped synthetic flow)
meta.data: data/ws/2026-09-29/14..23 and 2026-09-30/00..14 (.jsonl.gz, read-only); 2026-09-30/15.jsonl (being written) excluded; instruments data/rest/instruments/2026-09-30.json
meta.units: USD, bps (1e-4 relative), real ticks = max(10^-pd, 10^(floor(log10 p)-4)); convert USD to lots with round(usd/price*10^qd)
meta.classes: L50 = max_leverage 50 (SP500, NAS100, BTC, ETH); L20 = 20x (GOLD, WTIOIL, SILVER, SOL, HYPE, XRP, BRENTOIL, EWY); L10 = 10x (63 markets); L3-5 = 3x/5x small-cap crypto (13)

sample.hours: all 24 hour files 2026-09-29 14:00 .. 2026-09-30 14:59 UTC (hour 18 on 09-29 empty; 14 and 17 partial); ~22.6 covered hours

takers.event_definition: taker event = prints grouped by (instrument, side, exact trade ts ms); notional = sum(p*qty) in USD. 10.4 % of events span more than one ws frame; grouping by frame instead gives p50 $317 / p90 $2.49k / p99 $15.4k (the earlier comparison numbers).

notional_usd_sampler.algorithm: draw u~U(0,1): dust band (table) with share_dust, else a point mass (exact USD) with its share, else a 2-component lognormal mixture truncated to >= $12.5 (reject and redraw below). Convert USD to lots with qty = round(usd / price * 10^qd), at least 1 lot.
notional_usd_sampler.dust_simple: 93.6 % of dust in [10.5, 11.6) (roughly uniform over 10.7-11.4), 2.2 % at 10.0-10.1, the rest scattered (11.9-12.0, 12.4)

continuous_lognormal_mixture_truncated.fit: EM init, then Nelder-Mead on squared log-quantile error at 19 probabilities (tail weighted x2) of the truncated mixture

continuous_alt_inverse_cdf_table_ln_usd.use: u~U(0,1), find knot interval, interpolate ln(usd) linearly, exp

notional_usd_sampler.cap: cap each draw at the instrument max_market_notional (USD 50k / 500k / 1M by instrument); real max event USD 546k
notional_usd_sampler.peak_method: candidate round values (1,1.2,1.5,2,2.5,3,4,5,6,7,7.5,8,9 x 10^k); count within +-0.4 % minus background from the 1-5 % flanks; kept when excess >= 0.1 % of events and count >= 3x background; $257.24 found by a 0.2 % log-bin scan

fills_per_event.geometric_fit_note: P(fills=k) vs geometric with p=1/mean: see pmf

sample.hours: all recorded seconds 2026-09-29 14:00 .. 2026-09-30 14:59 UTC (24 hour files, ~22.6 covered hours, 88 markets)
sample.method: 1-s log returns in bps between consecutive server seconds (snapshots at ~900 ms of each second); mark = tickers.mark (exchange recomputes every ~200 ms), mid = (best bid + best ask)/2 from the book snapshot, dropped when the spread > max(3x the market median spread, 20 bps) (one-sided / flickering books); persistent jump = |r_1s| > thr and |ln(x[t+5]/x[t-1])| > thr/2; VR(h) = var(h-s return)/(h var(1-s return)); per-market sigma = stdev of 1-s returns; shape fitted on returns standardised by each market's RMS of nonzero returns; Student-t df by grid MLE (golden-section scale) on 40k subsample; normal scale mixture by EM; jumps = seconds with |r| > threshold
sample.classes: lev:L50 = max_leverage 50 (SP500, NAS100, BTC, ETH); L20 = 20x; L10 = 10x; L3-5 = 3x/5x small-cap crypto; equity split by US regular session 13:30-20:00 UTC

price_dynamics_1s.generator_recipe: per market: sigma_m ~ exp(N(ln_mean, ln_sd)) of its class (or the market own value from per_market); each second: with prob share_zero_change the price does not move; otherwise r_bps = (sigma_m / sqrt(1 - share_zero_change)) * z, z from normal_scale_mixture3 (pick component by w, then N(0, sd^2)) or the abs_z_quantile_table with a random sign. Returns are close to a random walk at 10-60 s (variance ratio ~1.0-1.2) with lag-1 autocorrelation ~0, so for 15 ms steps scale the diffusive part by sqrt(0.015) and put the >5 sigma moves in one step. Round to the market price grid.

sample.method: exchange-wide count per server second = sum over 88 markets of changed price levels between consecutive 1-s book snapshots (inside the window both snapshots cover); seconds used only when all 88 markets have a consecutive pair. msg_lb = fill-adjusted place/cancel lower bound + taker events (same as earlier comparison).

book_message_rate_lower_bound.note: msg_lb (fill-adjusted) is within 0.1 % of raw level changes because fills are rare; the 1-s snapshot count saturates when a market book changes completely (3.4 % of market-seconds have >= 40 changed levels), so true burstiness is at least this.

rate_multiplier_models.use: multiplier M_t = exp(sum_j s_j,t) / E[exp(.)], s_j,t = phi_j s_j,t-1 + N(0, innovation_sd_j^2), one step per second; offered rate at second t = base_rate * M_t. E[exp(x)] = exp(total_var/2); normalise by the simulated mean or by exp(var/2).

median_hour_2ar1.fit: least squares on the ACF of ln(C_t / hour mean) at lags 1..1800 s, variance = sample variance

pooled_3ar1_incl_hourly_level.fit: least squares on the ACF of ln(C_t / pooled mean) at lags 1..14400 s over the full hours
pooled_3ar1_incl_hourly_level.caveat: reproduces the ACF and p50-p99 but overshoots p99.9 and max (Gaussian log-rate is too heavy at the top when the hourly level and the fast part are simply added; busy hours are really smoother); prefer per-scenario hour models

burstiness_vs_level.use: var_ln(hour) ~ exp(intercept) * mean^slope: busier hours are relatively smoother (partly because per-market level-change counts saturate)

single_ar1_reference.note: decays too fast at long lags: acf(60) model 0.000 vs empirical 0.178

coupling_to_book_rate.use: taker rate_t = base_taker_rate * M_t^beta (M_t = book-rate multiplier), on top of the batch structure below

taker_cluster_process_50ms.definition: taker events chained when the gap to the previous exchange-wide event is <= 50 ms
taker_cluster_process_50ms.use: cluster starts ~ Poisson(cluster_rate * M_t^beta); size from pmf; members after the first at gaps drawn from within_cluster_gap_ms; market = same as previous with within_cluster_next_event_same_market_share else a new market; side = first side with within_cluster_same_side_as_first_share

sample.method: A: a market "moves" in second t when |1-s return| > 4x its own RMS of nonzero 1-s returns (top 0.1 %% trimmed); count movers per second (full-coverage seconds only), compare with the independence (Poisson-binomial) tail; shock = second with >= 8 movers, seconds within 2 s merged. B: 250-ms sliding windows over taker events (prints grouped by market, side, ts); clusters = maximal runs of windows with >= K distinct markets.

scheduled_windows: US cash open 13:30 UTC: 64 events (>= 8 movers) between 13:30 and 13:40 on 09-30, equity-dominated
US macro release 12:30 UTC (08:30 ET): one 71-market event, median |move| 36 bps, 222 taker events, 43 markets printing within 250 ms
arrival.clustering: inter-event gaps CV ~2.1-2.4 (not Poisson): use a calm Poisson rate plus scheduled/stress bursts

markets_per_event.selection: roughly uniform over markets (mover shares track the number of markets per class: L10 74 %, L3-5 17 %, L20 8 %, L50 2 %)

generator_shock_model.direction: one common sign per event; each mover takes it with probability ~0.95 (coherence p50 1.0, p10 ~0.8)

size.note: the detector requires > 4 sigma, so sizes are conditional on detection; large events (>= 50 movers) have median 20-37 bps, p90 42-69 bps

time_spread.biggest: 43 markets printed within 250 ms (2026-09-30 12:30:07.777), 48 markets / 78 taker events within 510 ms

accompanying_flow.taker_side: trade clusters with >= 10 markets in 250 ms are 97 % directional (>= 80 % same side)

taker_share.real: taker events <= 0.070 % of the message lower bound

taker_size.generator: uniform 1,000-20,000 lots at F ~1e5 ticks = USD 100-2,000 uniform

fair_value_diffusion.generator: delta uniform[-3,3] ticks per 15 ms: sd 2 ticks/step, ~16 ticks = ~1.2 bps per second at F ~1.34e5 ticks, never zero
fair_value_diffusion.real: 1-s mark sigma median 1.10 bps (L50 0.38, L20 0.75, L10 1.09, L3-5 1.84); 72 % of seconds the mark does not change

jumps.generator: P = 1/15,000 per 15 ms step: ~16 jumps per market-hour of 200-600 bps (stress by design, for liquidations)
jumps.real: persistent 1-s mark moves > 50 bps: 0.140 per market-hour, > 100 bps: 0.0111 per market-hour (all markets); none > 50 bps in the 50x markets

rate_shape.real: per-second p99/mean 1.65-3.18 and max/mean 1.98-6.34 depending on the hour

mark_cadence.real: exchange recomputes the mark about every 200 ms (earlier finding)
